title: An unusual day 很不平常的一天

script.textEN: It is eight o'clock. Mr. Mario is going to work.
script.textCN: 现在是8点钟。马里奥先生正要去上班。

script.textEN: He usually goes by car, but today he is walking.
script.textCN: 他通常开车去，但今天他正步行去。

script.textEN: It is morning. The children are playing in the garden.
script.textCN: 现在是早晨。孩子们正在花园里玩耍。
